name: Direct Relief
story: Every **{international: cost_total / (donor_cost_share * people_reached)|$}** gives a patient abroad a year of treatment, and every **{usa: cost_total / (donor_cost_share * people_reached)|$}** does the same for a patient in the US.
summary: A US medical aid charity that ships donated medicines and supplies, requested by partners, to health facilities in 92 countries and to safety-net clinics in all 50 US states, in emergencies (Ukraine, Gaza, Sudan, hurricanes and wildfires) and for routine care, and gives cash grants to local health organisations. Over 95% of its support is donated medicines, booked at US wholesale value.

lines.label: Medical aid abroad: donated medicines and supplies and grants to health partners
lines.source: https://www.directrelief.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/Direct-Relief-2025-Audit-FS-Report-Final.pdf (audited accounts, fiscal year to 30 June 2025, p. 7): international programme expenses $1,890,911k less donated goods distributed $1,621,563k, expired donated stock written off $197,863k and donated freight $1,302k = $70,183k of Direct Relief's own (cash) spending. Weights are cash, the money donations pay for: donated goods enter the models' credit share, not their cost.

lines.label: Medicines and grants for US safety-net clinics and disaster recovery
lines.source: https://www.directrelief.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/Direct-Relief-2025-Audit-FS-Report-Final.pdf (audited accounts, fiscal year to 30 June 2025, p. 7): USA programme expenses $402,371k less donated goods distributed $296,794k, expired donated stock written off $52,595k and donated freight $346k = $52,636k of cash spending.

spending.source: https://www.directrelief.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/Direct-Relief-2025-Audit-FS-Report-Final.pdf (audited accounts, fiscal year to 30 June 2025, pp. 6-7): programme expenses $2,293,282k as reported, of which $2,170,463k were non-cash (donated goods distributed $1,918,357k, expired donated stock $250,458k, donated freight $1,648k); cash programme spending $122,819k (USA $52,636k, international $70,183k).
